about.title: About Sailock
about.subtitle: An open-source password manager that's local, secure, and free.

mission.title: Your passwords are yours
mission.body: Sailock started from a simple idea: password management shouldn't depend on a cloud account or blind trust in a company. Everything is encrypted and stored on your own device — nothing leaves your machine unless you decide it should.

story.title: Our story
story.body: PENDING — awaiting your input on personal vs. product tone.

local.title: Local-first
local.description: Your vault is encrypted and stored on your own device. No servers, no accounts, no exceptions.

secure.title: Secure
secure.description: AES-256 encryption and two-factor authentication from the project's very first commit.

free.title: Free and open
free.description: Sailock is, and will remain, free. The code is on GitHub for anyone to review or contribute to.

involved.title: Get involved
involved.description: Sailock is open source — any idea, bug report, or pull request is welcome.
